hero.subheadline: Track all your investments, assets and liabilities. Know your true net worth with automatic updates across bank accounts, stocks, crypto, precious metals and more.

features.cryptoDescription: Import your Bitpanda holdings automatically with a read-only API key.
features.metalsDescription: Track gold and silver bars and coins, valued at current dealer prices.
features.liabilitiesDescription: Track your loans and repayment schedules. See your true net worth.

steps.createDescription: Sign up with your email or a social login. Access opens gradually through a waitlist. No credit card required.
steps.netWorthDescription: Watch your complete wealth picture come together, refreshed automatically every day.

security.description: We never see your bank credentials. Access tokens and API keys are stored encrypted, and every connection is read-only.

cta.description: Bring your accounts, holdings and loans together and see your whole net worth in one place.
